-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def (sealed) smd.isConflictL : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.merge.Conflict → List
    (GoString × smd.Path) → IProp GF

def smd.instDecidableEqApplyOutcome : DecidableEq smd.ApplyOutcome :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | smd.ApplyOutcome.ok o m, smd.ApplyOutcome.ok o' m' => decidable_of_iff (o = o' ∧ m = m') ⋯
  | smd.ApplyOutcome.conflicts c, smd.ApplyOutcome.conflicts c' => decidable_of_iff (c = c') ⋯
  | smd.ApplyOutcome.ok obj mf, smd.ApplyOutcome.conflicts cs => isFalse ⋯
  | smd.ApplyOutcome.conflicts cs, smd.ApplyOutcome.ok obj mf => isFalse ⋯

def smd.keysWithItems (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : List smd.PE) (fl : smd.FieldList),
    ((∃ n v, (n, v) ∈ fl ∧ p ++ [smd.PE.key fl, smd.PE.field n] ∈ s) → p ++ [smd.PE.key fl] ∈ s) ∧
      (p ++ [smd.PE.key fl] ∈ s →
          (∃ fs e rel,
              ((smd.typeAlong S (some t) (p ++ [smd.PE.key fl])).bind fun t => S.find t.name) =
                  some (smd.Atom.map fs e rel) ∧
                rel ≠ smd.ElemRel.atomic) →
            ∀ (n : GoString) (v : smd.UVal), (n, v) ∈ fl → p ++ [smd.PE.key fl, smd.PE.field n] ∈ s) ∧
        ∀ (n : GoString) (v : smd.UVal) (r : List smd.PE),
          (n, v) ∈ fl → r ≠ [] → ¬p ++ [smd.PE.key fl, smd.PE.field n] ++ r ∈ s

def smd.inputsSmall (xs : List smd.UVal) (mf : smd.MF) : Prop :=
  (List.map smd.UVal.size xs).sum < smd.smdSizeMax ∧ smd.FSet.card (smd.mfUnion mf).nodes < smd.smdSizeMax

def (sealed) smd.isIdentityConverter (cv : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.merge.Converter) :
    IProp GF

def smd.addBackOwned (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (merged pruned : smd.UVal) (managed :
    smd.PathSet) : smd.UVal :=
  smd.removeItems S t merged
    ((smd.ensureNamed S t (smd.fieldSet S t merged)).diff
      ((smd.ensureNamed S t (smd.fieldSet S t pruned)).union (smd.ensureNamed S t managed)))

def smd.applyResult (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (rion : Bool) (live config : smd.UVal) (ver :
    GoString) (mf : smd.MF) (mgr : GoString) (force : Bool) : smd.ApplyOutcome :=
  have mf0 := smd.reconcileMF S t mf;
  have merged := smd.merge S t live config;
  have mf1 := mf0.set mgr { set := smd.fieldSet S t config, version := ver, applied := true };
  have new := smd.prune S t merged mf1 (mf0.get mgr);
  have c := smd.compare S t live new;
  have confl := smd.conflictsOf mf1 mgr c;
  if (!force && !confl.isEmpty) = true then smd.ApplyOutcome.conflicts confl
  else
    smd.ApplyOutcome.ok (if (!rion && decide (new = live)) = true then none else some new)
      (smd.afterUpdate mf1 mgr confl c.removed)

inductive smd.ApplyOutcome : Type
  | smd.ApplyOutcome.ok (obj : Option smd.UVal) (mf : smd.MF) : smd.ApplyOutcome
  | smd.ApplyOutcome.conflicts (cs : smd.FSet (GoString × smd.Path)) : smd.ApplyOutcome

def smd.addBackOwnedMF (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (merged pruned : smd.UVal) (mf : smd.MF) :
    smd.UVal :=
  match mf with
  | [] => pruned
  | head :: tail => smd.addBackOwned S t merged pruned (smd.mfUnion mf)

def (sealed) smd.isConflicts (s : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.merge.Conflicts) (cs : List
    (GoString × smd.Path)) : IProp GF

def smd.mfUnion (mf : smd.MF) : smd.PathSet :=
  List.foldr (fun me acc => me.snd.set.union acc) smd.PathSet.empty mf

def smd.kwiAt (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) : smd.Path → smd.Path → Bool :=
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => smd.Path → Bool) x✝ (smd.kwiAt._f S t s) x✝¹

def smd.reconcileMF (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (mf : smd.MF) : smd.MF :=
  List.map
    (fun x =>
      match x with
      | (m, e) => (m, { set := smd.reconcile S t e.set, version := e.version, applied := e.applied }))
    mf

def smd.prune (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (merged : smd.UVal) (mf : smd.MF) (last : Option
    smd.VSet) : smd.UVal :=
  match last with
  | none => merged
  | some L =>
    if L.set.IsEmpty then merged
    else
      have ens := smd.ensureNamed S t;
      have fieldsOf := fun v => ens (smd.fieldSet S t v);
      have p0 := smd.removeItems S t merged (ens L.set);
      have p1 := smd.removeItems S t merged ((fieldsOf merged).diff ((fieldsOf p0).union (ens (smd.mfUnion mf))));
      smd.removeItems S t merged (((fieldsOf merged).diff (fieldsOf p1)).inter (ens L.set))

def smd.afterUpdate (mf : smd.MF) (mgr : GoString) (confl : smd.FSet (GoString × smd.Path)) (removed
    : smd.PathSet) : smd.MF :=
  List.filterMap
    (fun x =>
      match x with
      | (m, e) =>
        have s := if m = mgr then e.set else (e.set.diff (smd.conflictsOfMgr confl m)).diff removed;
        if s.IsEmpty then none else some (m, { set := s, version := e.version, applied := e.applied }))
    mf

def smd.conflictsMF (mf : smd.MF) (mgr : GoString) (c : smd.Cmp) : smd.MF :=
  List.filterMap
    (fun x =>
      match x with
      | (m, e) =>
        if m = mgr then none
        else
          have s := e.set.inter (c.modified.union c.added);
          if s.IsEmpty then none else some (m, { set := s, version := e.version, applied := false }))
    mf

def (sealed) smd.isConflict (x : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.merge.Conflict) (c : GoString
    × smd.Path) : IProp GF

def smd.updateResult (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (live new : smd.UVal) (ver : GoString) (mf :
    smd.MF) (mgr : GoString) : smd.MF :=
  have mf0 := smd.reconcileMF S t mf;
  have c := smd.compare S t live new;
  have mf2 := smd.afterUpdate mf0 mgr (smd.conflictsOf mf0 mgr c) c.removed;
  have base :=
    match mf2.get mgr with
    | some e => e.set
    | none => smd.PathSet.empty;
  have s := ((base.diff c.removed).union c.modified).union c.added;
  if s.IsEmpty then List.filter (fun me => me.fst != mgr) mf2
  else mf2.set mgr { set := s, version := ver, applied := false }

def smd.mfPairs (mf : smd.MF) : smd.FSet (GoString × smd.Path) :=
  List.foldr (fun me acc => (smd.FSet.map (fun p => (me.fst, p)) me.snd.set).union acc) smd.FSet.empty mf

def (sealed) smd.isVSetOpt (i : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.VersionedSet) :
    Option smd.VSet → IProp GF

def smd.instDecidableInputsSmall (xs : List smd.UVal) (mf : smd.MF) : Decidable (smd.inputsSmall xs
    mf) :=
  smd.instDecidableInputsSmall._aux_1 xs mf

def smd.conflictsOfMgr (cs : smd.FSet (GoString × smd.Path)) (m : GoString) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.FSet.bind (fun mp => if mp.fst = m then [mp.snd] else []) cs

def (sealed) smd.isUpdater (u : Loc) (cv : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.merge.Converter)
    (igf igfl : GoMap) (rion : Bool) : IProp GF

def smd.addBackDangling (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (merged pruned : smd.UVal) (last :
    smd.PathSet) : smd.UVal :=
  smd.removeItems S t merged
    (((smd.ensureNamed S t (smd.fieldSet S t merged)).diff (smd.ensureNamed S t (smd.fieldSet S t pruned))).inter
      (smd.ensureNamed S t last))

def smd.conflictsOf (mf : smd.MF) (mgr : GoString) (c : smd.Cmp) : smd.FSet (GoString × smd.Path) :=
  List.foldr
    (fun me acc =>
      if me.fst = mgr then acc
      else (smd.FSet.map (fun p => (me.fst, p)) (me.snd.set.inter (c.modified.union c.added))).union acc)
    smd.FSet.empty mf

def smd.keysWithItemsB (S : smd.Schema) (t : smd.TypeRef) (s : smd.PathSet) : Bool :=
  smd.FSet.all (smd.kwiAt S t s []) s
